cause: ConfigMap/flagd-config (flag paymentUnreachable set to on by flag-admin at 17:19:28)
diagnosis: All checkout journeys fail with HTTP 500 starting at 17:19:30. Two changes landed seconds before the alert: flag-admin set paymentUnreachable from off to on at 17:19:28, and ci-bot rolled payment to 1.8.3 at 17:19:30. The payment pod is Running, ready, with 0 restarts and logs show the gRPC server started, so the payment service itself is up. The flag description is 'Payment service is unavailable', and its on-state makes checkout's payment calls fail, which explains the 500s. The flag is the fault; the release is not the cause. Reverting the flag to off restores the baseline.
